name: stockin
description: 个人自用进货统计 Web 应用（pnpm workspace monorepo）

scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:web && pnpm run lint:server
scripts.lint:server: oxlint apps/server/src packages/domain/src packages/shared/src && oxfmt --check apps/server/src packages/domain/src packages/shared/src packages/domain/tests packages/shared/tests apps/server/tests
scripts.format: oxfmt apps/server/src packages/domain/src packages/shared/src packages/domain/tests packages/shared/tests apps/server/tests
